subject: Maple Retail POC outcomes — quick customer soundbite & brief call?
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@mapleretail.com>, Tom Nguyen <tnguyen@mapleretail.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Maple Retail POC outcomes — quick customer soundbite & brief call?

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Thanks again for running the POC with us — really appreciated the partnership. Quick recap of the outcomes from the POC (attached PDF has full breakdown):

- Indexing + search rerank reduced latency on lookup flows from ~320ms to ~95ms for typical queries (median).
- End-to-end query cost per 1K sessions fell by ~46% with our batching + prefix cache changes.
- Conversion on the test cohort increased from 3.1% to 4.4% (+42% relative) over the 7-day window we measured.

We’re preparing a short customer spotlight (1–2 paragraph summary + 15–30s clip option). Would you be open to either: 1) a 2–3 sentence written quote we can publish, or 2) a quick 15-minute recorded call (we’ll record, we can provide a short script) for a short audio clip? If written quote, a couple lines on the business impact would be ideal. If you pick the call, we’ll keep it to 15 minutes and send an agenda in advance.

Attached: Maple_POC_kpis.pdf (detailed metrics) — and a draft permission consent we can send over if that helps. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If you’re ok with a written quote, would appreciate it by end of day Friday so we can include it in next week’s release notes. If you prefer the call, let me know a couple windows that work and we’ll schedule.

Thanks — really excited about the early results and would love to highlight Maple Retail as a reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0162
Attachments: Maple_POC_kpis.pdf (pdf)

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@mapleretail.com>

Tessa —

Great to see the summary, and thanks for the clear bullets. The team here is pleased with the latency and conversion lift; those numbers line up with our analytics dashboard. Happy to provide a short written blurb. Tom will coordinate schedules for the 15-minute call option if you still want to record an audio snippet.

Two quick lines we can start with (feel free to edit):
"Working with Redwood Inference reduced lookup latency significantly and improved our conversion metrics on targeted flows. The platform's batching and cache tuned approach gave us predictable performance at lower cost."

We’re comfortable publishing that with attribution to Maple Retail. For the recording, I’ll hand off to Tom to propose times.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
